name: daxil
description: Local video editor and compressor powered by FFmpeg
author: Andrew Porasl <andrew@porasl.com>

scripts.package: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run release:assets && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64 --publish never
